nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Green manufacturing methods|Environmental performance monitoring_qna_001
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What were some key findings regarding the environmental management systems of the participating factories?
nodes.answer: The key findings included gaps in the actual and prioritized action plans, with Factory A excelling and Factory B and C scoring significantly lower.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Green manufacturing methods|Environmental performance monitoring_qna_002
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: Why do the eco-indices scores vary significantly in different facilities and production stages?
nodes.answer: The eco-indices scores vary due to unsustainable practices prevailing despite having international compliance policies, limited sustainable approaches, and lack of attention to pollution control.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Green manufacturing methods|Environmental performance monitoring_qna_003
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What factors contribute to the poor environmental performance in the knit production industry in Bangladesh?
nodes.answer: Factors such as limited resources, strategic planning, knowledge sharing, finance, neglect towards factory by-products, and faulty recording systems contribute to poor environmental performance in the knit production industry in Bangladesh.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Green manufacturing methods|Environmental performance monitoring_qna_004
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How can monitoring the critical levels of combined performance indicators help in managing potential dead stocks before they become a problem?
nodes.answer: By monitoring critical levels of combined performance indicators, potential dead stocks can be identified and managed in a timely manner, preventing them from escalating into a larger issue within the system.
